note: F1's Bahrain Grand Prix, raced in Malaysia, and the Patriots' away game at Buffalo both kick off later today.

front.title: Apple confirms iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T issue needs hardware replacement
front.tldr: Apple says a small number of iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T's network lose cellular service and must be physically replaced, not fixed by a software update.

front.title: Verstappen takes Red Bull's first pole of 2026 in Malaysia
front.tldr: Max Verstappen out-qualified Lewis Hamilton at Sepang for Red Bull's first pole of the season, a rare bright spot in a difficult year. The Bahrain Grand Prix, held in Malaysia, starts tonight.

front.title: We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything
front.tldr: Simon Willison argues that AI and other usage-billed products need hard spending caps by default, not just alerts, after seeing people rack up surprise bills with no warning.

stories.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs
stories.tldr: Amazon Web Services pushed back on criticism of its data centre practices, saying it has dropped non-disclosure agreements that limited what nearby communities could say about facilities.

stories.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claims company's 'culture is broken'
stories.tldr: David Robinson left OpenAI's safety team warning that its culture undermines its own safety commitments, the latest in a run of departures from AI labs' safety teams this year.

stories.title: This app displays song lyrics on Apple CarPlay
stories.tldr: A widget called Dynamic Lyrics brings synced song lyrics to Apple CarPlay, turning any drive into an impromptu karaoke session.

stories.title: Vessev built an electric ferry that almost flies
stories.tldr: New Zealand's Vessev has built an electric hydrofoil ferry designed to lift above the water, cutting fuel use and noise on short sea crossings.

stories.title: Spotify billionaire's body scan startup has come to America
stories.tldr: Neko Health, the full-body scanning startup backed by Spotify's Daniel Ek, has launched in the US, betting that preventative health screening can go mainstream.

stories.title: Here's why I upgraded from the Apple Watch Series 10 to Series 12
stories.tldr: A long-time Apple Watch holdout explains why the Series 12's upgrades were enough to retire a Series 10 bought only in January.

stories.title: Indie App Spotlight: 'HEVCut' helps you trim your photo library without deleting anything
stories.tldr: HEVCut is a small iPhone app that shrinks photo library size by re-encoding video clips, without deleting a single memory.

stories.title: Watch F1 on Apple TV tonight, free for everyone in the US
stories.tldr: Apple TV is streaming the Bahrain Grand Prix, raced in Malaysia, free and without a subscription for US viewers this weekend.

stories.title: 'A Statement' review: a top ensemble breathes vitality into a dry docu-drama
stories.tldr: Tom McCarthy's NYFF premiere, starring Paul Rudd, Amy Ryan and John Turturro, dramatises a 1980 conference on the climate crisis; critics say the cast elevates otherwise talky material.

stories.title: Why Tony Gilroy needed nine composers to score 'Behemoth!'
stories.tldr: Tony Gilroy's New York Film Festival premiere 'Behemoth!' used nine different composers for its score, a rare approach Variety breaks down track by track.

stories.title: Tom Cruise's 'Digger' plunges at the box office with under $10m
stories.tldr: Alejandro G. Iñárritu's 'Digger', starring Tom Cruise, opened to less than $10 million, on course for one of Cruise's weakest openings in nearly two decades.

stories.title: Denver Film Festival unveils lineup and honorees
stories.tldr: Denver Film Festival will open with Peter Farrelly's 'I Play Rocky' and close with James Gray's 'Paper Tiger', while honouring Carrie Coon and John Cho among others.

stories.title: Pierre Le Gall's 'Flesh and Fuel' named best film at Zurich Film Festival
stories.tldr: The French drama, which premiered in Cannes' Critics' Week, won the Golden Eye, the top prize at the 22nd Zurich Film Festival.

stories.title: The ultimate student for Boston's shooting development school
stories.tldr: The Celtics' reputation for developing shooters continues, with one player singled out as the programme's standout example this off-season.

stories.title: Patriots elevate two DBs from practice squad ahead of Bills clash
stories.tldr: New England has elevated safety Mike Brown and cornerback Kindle Vildor from the practice squad, adding depth to a thin secondary for Sunday's game at Buffalo.

stories.title: Patriots downgrade rookie cornerback Channing Canada on eve of Bills matchup
stories.tldr: Rookie cornerback Channing Canada has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills, the third active-roster Patriot to miss the trip to Orchard Park.

stories.title: Patriots worried about 'second play' with Bills QB Josh Allen
stories.tldr: New England's defence is bracing for Josh Allen's improvisation after the snap, not just his arm, ahead of Sunday's AFC East clash at Buffalo.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton labels Sepang qualifying his 'best lap' of the 2026 season
stories.tldr: Hamilton says his front-row qualifying lap at Sepang, alongside pole-sitter Verstappen, was the best of his season so far for Ferrari.

stories.title: Mercedes expected to gain three-tenths from upgrade but lost five, says Wolff
stories.tldr: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff admits a new aerodynamic package meant to add pace instead left the car slower and draggier through Malaysia's low-speed corners.

stories.title: What to watch for in the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
stories.tldr: Formula1.com's race-day preview flags Verstappen and Hamilton's front row, Mercedes' troubled upgrade, and the first wet-weather threat of the regulation era.

stories.title: Red Sox DH Mickey Gasper undergoes surgery to repair torn bicep
stories.tldr: Mickey Gasper had surgery to repair a torn distal biceps tendon shortly after Boston's elimination from the playoffs.

stories.title: The Red Sox need a lineup overhaul. It's complicated, though.
stories.tldr: Boston's bats went quiet when the Yankees eliminated them, and fixing the lineup will mean hard decisions about last winter's signings, not just new additions.

read.why: A craft-your-pitch guide drawn from Pinterest, Dropbox and DoorDash, useful for a product marketer who finds the story inside a launch.
read.title: How to kickstart and scale a consumer business—Step 3: Craft your pitch
read.subtitle: Lessons from Pinterest, Netflix, Tinder, Dropbox, DoorDash, Robinhood, Amazon, WhatsApp, and dozens of today’s most successful consumer businesses

listen.why: A deep dive on building a sports league into a business, relevant on a Sunday with F1 and the Patriots both live.

finally.title: Luxury ocean liners inform New York's Kimpton Era hotel by INC
finally.tldr: Architecture studio INC designed every room at New York's 529-key Kimpton Era hotel, overlooking Rockefeller Plaza, to feel like a stateroom on a classic ocean liner.
